newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices steady in dull trade.

text.p: Sugar prices were steady in narrow price band on Tuesday, dealers said.
Consumer demand and retail enquiries ahead of Christmas was lower than expected but restricted arrivals held the market from slipping, they said.
In the ready delivery, S 30 was quiet at 1,280/1,315 rupees per quintal while M 30 was steady at 1,300/1,360.
Sugar mill delivery also was unchanged at 1,215/1,230 rupees per quintal in thin activity.
